sourceRecords.title: Encomara Floating Wind Installation Technology Gets ABS Design Approval
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that Encomara Squid floating wind installation technology received Product Design Assessment certification from ABS. The source states that Squid integrates pre-installed mooring lines and electrical connections into a single subsea unit for plug-and-play connection.
